answer: One agent, one glacier post: it stakes 70 credits for a cipher-sealed berth. Each epoch it sends a fresh gale reading; a monitor checks the cipher seal and reading against the log. Silence, a copied seal, or a borrowed reading forfeits the bond, freeing the berth. First berth 52, k-th 52+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,549,500 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-watch ring cannot fake a thousand live readings. A watcher pays 52 once, keeping stake and reward.
